_comment: Parade Ground: the main menu's new no-enemy battle option, shown with the real default spawn (drill:true, no scenario override) so the clip matches exactly what pressing the button produces -- the standard 5-unit player line (seed 12345: Spearmen/Infantry/Archers/Cavalry/Cavalry, uid 0-4, x 120-1356.09, y 300) and zero enemy units. The whole line is box-selected, then ordered forward as a group with a single move click, so it marches south holding formation and settles -- ordinary maneuver controls, free of any opponent, which is the rehearsal space the feature adds. Driven live through the real SelectionManager by tools/demo/DemoInputRecorder.gd; world coordinates; physics ticks (60/s).

overlap.reason: The gesture orders all five regiments to one ground point, so blocks interpenetrate at the rally point by design of the demonstration; the wider 2x/4x pitches deepen the pileup (uid0 and uid1 min neighbour dips at the destination). Measured on the density re-pin.

shape_residual.reason: The far cavalry block (uid4, spawning at x=1356 under the new table) travels farthest to the shared rally point and is still crossing/reforming at the final samples (residual 71 wu vs the 30 wu threshold). In-transit deformation of the longest march, not a standing formation defect; measured on the density re-pin.
